title: 🌸說到 ☄️雖然也想跟大家一起玩Holonalds 但因為工作太忙的關係 所以整個一月應該都是沒辦法了 🌸又說到🌸☄️和姊街 一起去了手相的占卜🔮 而且是在☄️難得的休息日 🔮說了…
context:
🌸說到
☄️雖然也想跟大家一起玩Holonalds
但因為工作太忙的關係
所以整個一月應該都是沒辦法了
🌸又說到🌸☄️和姊街
一起去了手相的占卜🔮
而且是在☄️難得的休息日
🔮說了對🌸來說今年是準備和挑戰的一年
而對🌸☄️兩人來說2026年將會是非常好的一年

🌸繼續說著
去年🌸☄️也和一大群人去過🔮
那時的🔮也告訴🌸☄️兩人
2026年將會是一個對🌸☄️來說非常重要的一年
兩個不同的🔮都說了一樣的話

看來今年開始🌸☄️兩人即將進入下一個階段了呢

另外🌸也說到雖然沒那麼容易
但自己還是很想辦2nd Live
而且既然2026看來會是個不錯的一年
自己也會很期待

🌸 mentioned:
Although ☄️would like to play Holonalds with everyone,
because work has been so busy,
she probably won’t be able to join them on January.

🌸 also said 🌸☄️ went to a palmistry fortune-telling session 🔮
together with Anemachi during ☄️’s rare day off.
🔮 mentioned that this year will be a year of preparation and challenges for 🌸,
and for both 🌸 and ☄️, 2026 will be a very good year.

🌸 continued, saying
last year 🌸☄️ also went to a🔮 with a big group of people.
Back then, the🔮 also said that 2026
would be a very important year for 🌸☄️.
Hearing the same thing from two different🔮,
it seems like 🌸☄️ will be entering a new stage starting this year.

In addition, 🌸 mentioned that
although it won’t be easy, she really wants to hold a 2nd Live.
And since 2026 seems like it will be a good year,
she’s really looking forward to it!
🎹配信聊到
🌸☄️原本在☄️本月難得的休假那天
有約要吃起士鍋
☄️當時有再約🎹過來一起吃
但🎹覺得去當💡不好
所以本來沒有要去的
結果後來🌸閃到背去不了
☄️就跟🎹說妳還是過來吃吧
🎹又再找了🐧
🐧因為工作關係晚點才能到
🎹先到了☄️🏠
看到☄️🏠姐妹的日常相處讓🎹覺的很新鮮

而重點是
之後姊街對於🌸不來了的反應是
🌸是主催者怎麼能不來
所以又把背痛的🌸硬是叫來了⋯

🎹 talked during the stream about
🌸☄️ originally planned to have cheese fondue on ☄️’s rare day off this month.
☄️ even invited 🎹 to join them,
but 🎹 felt it wouldn’t be right to go as a💡,
so she initially decided not to go.

However, 🌸 hurt her back and couldn’t make it.
☄️ then told 🎹, “You should just come eat anyway.”
🎹 ended up inviting 🐧 as well.
Since 🐧 had work, she could only arrive later,
so 🎹 arrived at ☄️’s house first.

Seeing the everyday interactions between ☄️ and her sister at home felt really refreshing for 🎹.

The highlight, though, was when Anemachi reacted to 🌸 not coming, saying,
“🌸 is the organizer, how can she not show up?”
In the end, Anemachi insisted on bringing injured 🌸 over…
